title: feat(studio): the Studio AI panel matches the console's AI assistant
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB82ZDV2ys7SBHwCdUAguKiU)_

Fixes #34725

Child of epic #34571, the Studio half of #34608. Built on #34713 (merged 14619f54).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 右侧的 AI 面板与控制台的 AI 助手抽屉统一。名称统一为「AI 助手」。顶栏右端换成控制台同一个机器人按钮，只负责开关右栏，`⌘.` 保留。标题栏收成一行：属性 | AI 助手，加历史、铺满、关闭。用量和分享移进历史视图。默认宽 420，可拖动。上下文 chip 显示「正在看：任务 · 记录」。数据画布上，AI 改过的字段在表格列头和表单卡片上带草稿标记，画布上方有一行「AI 刚改了 N 处」，带「查看」和「放弃全部未发布改动」。
- 为什么改：#34725 的 8 项，对齐 #34608 / PR #34665 的控制台抽屉。第 4 项（原地铺满）和第 8 项（结果卡不带发布）已由 #34713 完成，这里没有重做。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台前端（app-shell；components 一个可选成员；i18n studio 新键和几处文案值），不动元数据、契约和服务端。回滚即 revert。
- 偏差：第 7 项（验收 4）的「表格列头标记」只对已发布字段生效。AI 新加的字段是草稿，Studio 表格只选已发布字段（cloud#1652），发布前没有这一列，表单卡片和画布那一行照样标出。席位已认可。
- 先看：`StudioRightSlot.tsx`（单行标题栏、拖宽）、`StudioAiCopilot.tsx`（历史视图）、`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的顶栏机器人与 DataPillar 的草稿标记和那一行、`studio-tokens.ts`（顶栏按自身宽度显示支柱名）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/__tests__/studioRightSlot-12725.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.copilotChangesLine-34725.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/__tests__/studioCopilotSlotBody-12725.test.tsx packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-columnMarks-34725.test.tsx`，预期全部通过。

## What changes

**One name.** `engine.studio.aiCopilot` and `engine.studio.draftMark.agent.copilot` read "AI Assistant" / 「AI 助手」, so the panel, its tab, the folded strip and the draft-source sentence all use the console's name. The drafts panel's `preview.changes.draftedByCopilot` follows ("AI assistant") in every pack that said copilot.

**The robot in the top bar** (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`). With a copilot served, the top bar's right-most control is the console's `AssistantTopBarButton`, under a `ChatDockControlProvider` whose `toggle` shows or hides the right slot and always opens it on the AI assistant. `⌘.` still switches the halves. Without a copilot the panel icon (`studio-slot-toggle`) stays for the properties.

**One header row** (`StudioRightSlot.tsx`). Left: the Properties | AI Assistant switch, or the title when only one half exists. Right, while the assistant shows: History, widen (the #34713 control, moved here) and Close. `ChatPane` gains an optional `hideHeader` so the copilot draws no second header. History lays the conversation list (`ConversationsSidebar` with the console drawer's callbacks), Share and the usage reading over the chat; the pane stays mounted underneath, so a streaming answer is never cut. Picking a row opens that conversation; New chat asks for a fresh one.

**Width** (`studioRightSlotState.ts`). The slot opens at the console drawer's 420 px (`DOCK_DEFAULT_WIDTH`), resizes from its left edge by pointer or arrow keys, clamps with `clampDockWidth` (the canvas keeps 520 px), and remembers its width under its own key `studio-right-slot-width`, never the console's. Widened, it takes `wideWidth` and drops the handle. On a phone it stays the overlay.

**The top bar keeps its right end on screen** (`studio-tokens.ts`). With a resizable slot, a 1163 px window can leave the top bar 520 px. The pillar names used the viewport's `lg`, so in en the bar overflowed and the robot sat under the slot (live reading below). The names, "All metadata" and Create app now answer a container query on the bar (`@container/studio-header`): 724 px and 920 px, the widths the old breakpoints gave beside the old fixed slot.

**The context chip.** The Data pillar reports the open object's label and the view on screen (`Task · Records`, `Task · Form`), so the chip reads 「正在看：任务 · 记录」; `console.ai.discussing` reads Viewing / 正在看 in all 11 packs. The internal name stays on the chip's tooltip only where no label is known (objectui#7254).

**Draft marks on the canvas** (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` DataPillar, `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`). From the open object's existing draft read (`draftChanges`, no new server read):
- the Form canvas's card of each field an AI tool changed carries the 草稿 chip;
- the records grid's column header does too, through a new optional `GridFieldAuthoring.columnMarks` that `data-table` draws after the header label;
- a line over the canvas counts the AI entries (「AI 刚改了 N 处」, with a singular), with 查看 (opens the pending-changes sheet in review) and 放弃全部未发布改动 (confirm, then `packages.discardDrafts(packageId)`). A failed discard names each item as the rail does (the object's label, else its name, joined by a translated separator) and keeps the server's own words under the strip's Details. There is no per-turn undo.

**i18n.** New studio-namespace keys only: `engine.studio.slot.history`, `engine.studio.slot.resize`, `engine.studio.copilotChanges.{lineOne,line,view,discardAll,discardConfirm,discardFailed,itemSeparator}`. Changed values: the two studio keys above, `console.ai.discussing` (11 packs, zh-Hant regenerated), `preview.changes.draftedByCopilot` (en and eight packs; ar already said مساعد الذكاء الاصطناعي and is waived in `ui/scripts/i18n-en-drift-baseline.json`, the ratchet `WAIVER_CEILING` 6 → 7 with its history line). Two inline `defaultValue`s now copy their en value. `engine.studio.slot.openFullPage` is no longer read; retiring it is a separate change.

## Why

#34725 asks Studio's AI panel to be the console's AI assistant: one name, one entry, one width, one title bar (figure 20 on the card). #34608 / PR #34665 shipped the console drawer this matches; #34713 (ADR-0057 Amendment A3) made the widen control widen in place.

## Acceptance notes

- Items 4 (widen in place and restore) and 8 (no Publish on result cards) were done by #34713; measured on its head and not redone.
- Item 7 (acceptance 4), grid column marks: a field the assistant **adds** is a draft, and the Studio records grid selects published fields only (cloud#1652), so it has no column until published. Changed published fields are marked on their column; added fields are marked on their Form card and counted in the line. The seat accepted this deviation; no follow-up card.
- The robot sits at the right end of Studio's top bar, the console's place for it. In Studio the slot runs the full height beside the bar, so the robot is left of the slot rather than at the window's edge.

## Verification

- **Live readings**, 1163 × 820 window, zh-CN and en, the real console (Vite) over a fresh showcase backend, standing in only for `/api/v1/ai/**` (agents list with a build agent, in-memory conversations). Script, logs and shots: `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat3/34725-live/`.
  - Acceptance 1: the robot's accessible name, the panel title and tab read 「AI 助手」 / "AI Assistant".
  - Acceptance 2: `topbar-ai-assistant` is the top bar's last control, pressed while the slot shows; clicking it hides the slot, clicking again opens it on the assistant; no `studio-slot-toggle` remains.
  - Acceptance 3: the header is one 44 px row: 「AI 助手」, 历史, 展开, 收起右栏. History shows Share, New and the two stand-in conversations.
  - Acceptance 4 (#34713's): widen takes the slot to 643 px (canvas 520) with the URL unchanged; the same control restores.
  - Acceptance 5: the slot opens at 420 px; a 100 px drag makes it 520 px, stored, and kept after a reload.
  - Chip: 「正在看：任务 · 记录」 / "Viewing: Task · Records", then 「· 表单」 / "· Form" on the Form tab.
  - Found and fixed by the en reading: with the slot at 520 px the en top bar overflowed and the robot sat under the slot (a click on it was intercepted). After the container query: the header's `scrollWidth` equals its `clientWidth` at 643 px and 520 px in both languages, and the robot is clickable.
- **Draft-mark readings (L1-b rework M1)**, head `c2034e76feb1bfa767fe16fe828bc45726271de7`, 1163 × 820, zh-CN and en, same rig, on an editable object: a writable package `com.qa.x` with object `x_ticket` (fields Title, Priority, Due on; one record so the grid draws its header), published, then a real draft staged over HTTP that relabels the published field `priority` to "Urgency". **Stand-in, stated plainly:** HTTP refuses `?surface=copilot` (`packages/rest/src/meta-save-request.ts`) and MCP has no metadata write, so the draft's ledger row says `by: "api"`; the page's draft read (`GET /api/v1/meta/object/x_ticket?state=draft…`) is relabelled `by: "copilot"` in flight. Nothing else of the read is touched, and the discard is the real `packages.discardDrafts`. Script `check2.mjs`, logs `*-m1-log.txt`, shots `*-m1-*.png` in the same folder.
  1. The line reads 「AI 刚改了 1 处」 with 放弃全部未发布改动 and 查看 / "The AI assistant just made 1 change" with "Discard all unpublished changes" and "Review".
  2. The records grid's Priority column header carries `studio-grid-column-draft-chip` (「草稿」 / "Draft", `data-draft-of="priority"`); the Form card "Urgency" carries `studio-form-field-draft-chip`. One chip each, on that field only.
  3. 查看 opens the 待发布的变更 / "Pending changes" sheet in review posture: the one row (Ticket · x_ticket · 更新 / Update) folded, nothing publishes until 全部发布 / "Publish all".
  4. 放弃全部未发布改动: the confirm reads 「放弃本包的全部未发布改动（包括你自己的）？此操作不可撤销。」 / "Discard every unpublished change in this package, yours included? This cannot be undone."; after OK the line is gone, grid column chips 1 → 0, form card chips 1 → 0, no refusal strip, and the server's draft read answers 404 `NO_DRAFT`.
  5. Ask-data table at the 420 px default: the build agent's stand-in answer is a 3-column markdown table (Priority · Open tickets · Average age (days)). It renders 313 px wide inside its own `overflow-x: auto` box whose `clientWidth` equals `scrollWidth` (313 = 313), the slot spans 743–1163, and no cell is clipped.
  6. With the field selected the header is one 44 px row: 属性 | AI 助手 tabs (Properties selected), and on the AI 助手 tab 历史 · 展开 · 收起右栏 / History · Expand · "Hide the right panel"; all five controls sit at y 8, 28 px high.
- **i18n budget** (seat ruling 08:40Z): on the merged tree (main dfbc316d, with #34713), a console build and `check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` read `i18n-locale-en` at **61,823 B gzip (60.4 KB of the 60.5 KB ceiling, headroom 177 B)**, exit 0; #34713's own reading was 61,824 B. New keys are in the studio namespace; the eager pack changed values only. The ceiling is untouched.
- **S1 (L1-b rework):** `DataPillar.copilotChangesLine-34725` gains a failed-discard case: the sentence names `Task` (the rail label) and `showcase_task_grid` (no label known) with the separator, holds neither `E_LOCKED` nor `object/`, and the raw `object/showcase_task: E_LOCKED…` sits under Details. 6/6 pass.
- **Tests:** after merging main, `views/studio-design`, `preview`, the chip pin, the column-marks pin and the drift-ledger test: 385 files, 2,997 tests, all green.
  - Re-pointed: the slot unit pins (420 px and resize instead of 300/360, the 「AI 助手」 strip, the overlay), the surface pins (`studio-slot-toggle` → the robot when a copilot is served; the panel icon without one), the slot-body pins (widen is the slot's now), the widen-in-place pin (mounts the slot around the copilot), the chip pins (正在看 and the object label), the pillar-name class pins.
  - New: the slot header (History, widen, Close, pressed states, phone), history (pick, New chat, Share), `DataPillar.copilotChangesLine-34725` (the line, singular, 查看, discard with and without confirm, the chip label, the person-written control), `ObjectFormDesigner.draftMarkedFields-34725`, `data-table-columnMarks-34725` (components), `ChatPane hideHeader`.
  - Five edited tests load `@objectstack/lint` at module top (`check:test-source-alias`).
- **Type-check:** app-shell `tsc` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, components `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`: exit 0. eslint on every changed file: 0 errors.
- **i18n gates:** `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` exit 0; `check:i18n-dead-keys` reports nothing new.
- **`dispatch-gates --ran`:** re-run in full on head `c2034e76` (after S1): 40 derived, 40 run, all exit 0, 0 not measured. On the previous head: 40 derived families ran on the final diff, 40 accounted for, 0 not measured. One first-run red, `check:test-source-alias` on the edited `narrowHeader-12509` pin, was answered with a module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` and re-run exit 0. The other 39 exit 0.
- **Overlap:** `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` on `c2034e76`: merges cleanly with main (7752cac7), #34677, #34799, #34825 and #34850.
- **Merges:** #34713's head merged into the branch as it moved, then `origin/main` after #34713 landed (conflicts were only #34713's own lines, whose main version equals the head already merged).

Clause-②: yes (widening — new studio-namespace locale keys, and one optional `columnMarks` member on the published `GridFieldAuthoring` interface of @object-ui/components)
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 block is the seat's maintainer summary.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
